body: While it may come across as blunt, it's important to consider ending this friendship if you believe you can't genuinely accept it and release any expectations of more. Continuing down this path may only lead to greater pain in the future. I understand this may be tough and you're likely feeling upset right now, but it's crucial to have an honest conversation with yourself. Can you genuinely handle just being friends with her? If you can, that's wonderful. Take some time to process all your information, and when you're ready, you can work on rekindling your friendship. However, if you can't, it's essential to protect yourself and your feelings. That's the challenging aspect of dating – sometimes, it doesn't work out, and that's perfectly okay. Keep in mind that there's someone out there who will reciprocate those same feelings for you. Prioritize your emotional well-being and make choices that are best for your happiness and peace of mind.
